author: baseline A: common primary-ammonium passivator cations from the perovskite literature and the group's published work, in screening-priority order
provenance: PEA+, TFPA+, PFPA+, TH+ (tyrammonium) and benzocaine-H+ are cations already studied with this group's DFT workflow (identities of the first four confirmed from the r2SCAN reference geometries); the rest are widely used alkyl/aryl ammonium passivators. Experimental status per molecule is NOT encoded here and must be checked before any novelty claim.
